## Kreative Technologies, LLC - Software Engineer

🔗 [Apply](https://kreative-technologies-llc.breezy.hr/p/e2c79f11aed3-software-engineer)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Software Engineer designing, testing, and maintaining client software, APIs, and database services at Kreative Technologies. Collaborating in Agile teams on features, fixes, and production support.
Software Engineer building tested APIs and services for Kreative Technologies' client systems
- Salary: $73,588 - $81,765 per year
- Tech stack: Angular, AWS, Azure, Cloud, Java, Python, React, SQL
- Designs, develops and tests software features and fixes
- Builds and maintains APIs, services and database interactions
- Writes unit and integration tests
- Participates in code reviews and design discussions
- Troubleshoots defects and supports production issues
- Participates in sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives
- Documents code and technical changes
- Performs other duties as assigned
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field required
- 3+ years of software engineering experience
- Experience with Java, C#, Python or a similar language
- Experience with SQL and relational databases
- Experience with Git and Agile development practices
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to work independently in a remote environment
- Continually required to use common office equipment including but not limited to computers, phones, scanners and printers

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Software Engineer designing, testing, and maintaining client software, APIs, and database services at Kreative Technologies. Collaborating in Agile teams on features, fixes, and production support.
Software Engineer building tested APIs and services for Kreative Technologies' client systems
Role description:
• Designs, develops and tests software features and fixes
• Builds and maintains APIs, services and database interactions
• Writes unit and integration tests
• Participates in code reviews and design discussions
• Troubleshoots defects and supports production issues
• Participates in sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives
• Documents code and technical changes
• Performs other duties as assigned
Role requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field required
• 3+ years of software engineering experience
• Experience with Java, C#, Python or a similar language
• Experience with SQL and relational databases
• Experience with Git and Agile development practices
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work independently in a remote environment
• Continually required to use common office equipment including but not limited to computers, phones, scanners and printers
• Preferred: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
• Preferred: Experience with front-end frameworks such as Angular or React
• Preferred: Experience supporting federal government contracts
Tech stack:
Angular, AWS, Azure, Cloud, Java, Python, React, SQL
